text: An object that must be equipped or carried in inventory to ply a profession or skill. A broad definition of a tool is an entity used to interface between two or more domains that facilitates more effective action of one domain upon the other.

Tommy Joe Stonefield is a human quest giver located at the Stonefield Farm in Elwynn Forest. He and Maybell Maclure are madly in love with one another, but the eternal feud between their families is causing a terrible rift in their love. With the help of his grandmother Gramma Stonefield, he is able to meet Maybell in secrecy. He can be found on the bank of the river that runs near the Stonefield Farm. Tommy Joe is currently working in the Barn in Lunarfall along with several other Stonefield family members. It is revealed that he and Maybell Maclure are now married, as she has had an addition to her name and is now called Maybell Maclure-Stonefield.

A master archaeologist and well-known historian among the dwarves, a family fortune based on gemstone mines allowed Magellas to pursue the life of a scholar and discover the clues hinting at his race's divine heritage. Magellas' contributions to the Explorers' League helped build the Guildhall, and his wisdom earned him a place at the head of the Excursion Council. Officially, Magellas is High Explorer of the Guild, though is he often mistaken for a librarian as he spends nearly every day deep in the Guild Library searching for legends and myths that Guild explorers can be sent to investigate. The Ton'ma was an organization of ogres that captured Aliastra and her pack of savagekin. Aliastra managed to free herself and the other escapees; they killed three groups of Ton'ma, and after that the ogres raised the alarm. After some time the pack killed the best of the Ton'ma but they lost half of their wolves and a third of their sabercats. Eventually, they reached the upper levels of the caverns, where the light of the sun could be seen in cracks in the ceiling. In the gates stood the last Ton'ma ogres but they were swept aside by Aliastra and her pack finally emerging into open air.

Took the Red Eye Down is an achievement earned by damaging the Eye of Il'gynoth with 20 Nightmare Explosions in under 10 seconds during the Il'gynoth encounter in the Emerald Nightmare instance, on Normal difficulty or higher. The Nightmare Explosions required are caused when the adds known as Nightmare Ichors die. During phase one, these adds will spawn with a number of others (who are not needed for the achievement). To reach the next phase of the fight, the Ichors should be kited to the Eye of Il'gynoth near the cave's entrance and then nuked down; the resulting explosion damages the eye. For the achievement, simply group at least 20 of these Nightmare Ichors up and stack them on the Eye

.]] Torga, the turtle, is one of the loa of the Zandalari pantheon. He is a wise and benevolent loa, and the tortollan people used to make pilgrimages to him to hear his stories. However, Torga was killed by the blood trolls in Nazmir. They then consumed his flesh, and used his blood to raise undead and to summon Jungo, Herald of G'huun. The location where his corpse now lays is known as Torga's Rest. Bwonsamdi later summoned the Spirit of Torga as a way to speak to the turtle loa. Torga was later reincarnated as a young turtle and now sits atop the head of the tortollan Lashk. Tonai is a Zandalari child found sitting in the Hall of the Lesser Loa in Dazar'alor. During Talanji's coronation when riots erupted in the Terrace of the Chosen, he was seen crying in a corner of the hall.

Torcali is a direhorn loa revered by the Zandalari trolls. She is a loa of the harvest. Her worshipers are known as Torcalin, at the Terrace of Torcali. Torcali is the grass, and the bounties that heap the Zandalari's tables. She is the great shaper: Where she walks valleys form, and where she drags her horns rivers form. She does not have a temple because Zandalar itself is her place of worship. Where the road ends, Torcali's realm begins. Her domain stretches far beyond Zandalar. She is the greatmother of direhorns. Spectral versions of Torcali, Akunda, Kimbul, and Jani appear at Zanchul to observe Krag'wa's challenge to Princess Talanji.

Tony Jay (February 2, 1933 - August 13, 2006) was an English voice actor. He passed away from complications of a surgery to remove a non-cancerous tumor from his lung. He was planned to voice Drek'Thar in the cancelled Warcraft Adventures: Lord of the Clans game.
Tony Washington is the colorist of World of Warcraft: The Comic, World of Warcraft: Ashbringer and World of Warcraft: Lich King.
__NOTOC__ Tormus Deepforge is a dwarf quest giver located in the Great Forge in Ironforge.
Torn is a tauren banker located on the lower rise in Thunder Bluff.
__NOTOC__ Torm Ragetotem is a tauren warrior trainer located in the main building of the Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff.

__NOTOC__ Torta was a turtle found near Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris. She was waiting for her husband Tooga's return. Like him, she was capable of talking to you, although she would say nothing directly to you until you escorted Tooga back to her.
Torturing Poker is a rare one-hand dagger. It is very popular among twink rogues.

__NOTOC__ The Tormented Spirit is a rare mob banshee found patrolling the northwestern edge of the Agamand Mills in Tirisfal Glades. She is on a 1 to 2 hour respawn timer. Her and Lost Souls' appearance may be connected.
Tortoise Armor is a mail chestpiece that drops from Ghamoo-Ra in Blackfathom Deeps.
Torn Fin Eye is a quest item. It is sometimes used by members of the Royal Apothecary Society in brewing plagues and potions.
Tormek Stoneriver was a dwarf quest giver located in the Great Forge in Ironforge. He was only available during the Love is in the Air seasonal event.
Tork Wrench is a quest reward from Samophlange Manual (quest).

Torment of the Worgen is one of the books that can be found inside Sealed Tomes in the Guardian's Library in Karazhan. Using it grants you a 60 minute buff, giving your ranged and melee attacks a 3% chance to transform yourself into a worgen, dealing 200 additional shadow damage per hit, lasting 10 seconds.
Torn-heart Axe of Battle is a rare two-handed axe available as a quest reward from the quest The Cipher of Damnation (quest).
Toshley's Station Hero's Hat is an leather head armor. It gives bonuses to stamina, critical, and attack. This is Toshley's head gear.
Tortured Sentinels are night elf ghosts in the ruined village of Southwind in Silithus. When one is killed, a Hive'Ashi Drone may pop up from its corpse.
Torn Note is found inside the Half-Buried Bottle in Stranglethorn Vale.
__NOTOC__ Tortured Druids are night elf ghosts found in Southwind Village in Silithus.
Torn Scroll Fragment drops from Enraged Rock Elemental in Badlands.
__NOTOC__ Tortured Earth Spirits can be found in Nagrand. Killing the spirits will result in +10 reputation with Kurenai. They are visible in the Nagrand Arena.

Torturer LeCraft is a torturer of the Scarlet Onslaught found in the basement of the barracks at New Hearthglen, in Dragonblight, working at what appears to be an Alchemy Lab. Despite his status as a vile torturer, he begs for his life when tortured by you. Before he finishes his monologue, he states that Perhaps he is reminiscing about his own torturing experiences.
The Torn Pilgrim's Pack is found in Dustquill Ravine in Hellfire Peninsula.

Tormak the Scarred is the Chieftain of the Camp Oneqwah taunka. He works alongside Scout Vor'takh to aid the Horde's efforts in the area. He is primarily concerned with defeating the ancient enemy of the taunka, the iron dwarves in Dun Argol. Tormak ends up leaving Northrend to journey Azeroth with Sage Paluna. They eventually ended up on at Frostwall if the stables are built. Following the war against the Jailer, at some point he had returned to Camp Oneqwah and resumed Chieftain duties. The town has grown significantly since its original incarnation. Torseg's Rest is a subzone located northwest of K3. The frost giant can be found here sitting next to a fire and a large pack. It is unknown why or from where Torseg was exiled. Interestingly, only Torseg the Exiled and the Champions of Hodir (both hostile) are labeled as giants, while all the rest of their kind are humanoid.

Torment the Weak is a Mage talent in the Arcane tree. It increases damage dealt by Mage spells to targets under snare effects such as chills (like that of Frostbolt and Cone of Cold), the spell Slow or ASPD slows such as Thunder Clap.
Torp's Farm was a pig farm for Warsong Hold, however, it now lies in ruin from the Scourge attacks. It can be found in the Borean Tundra.
Torturer's Rod is dropped by Torturer Alphonse in New Hearthglen in Dragonblight.
Torthen Deepdig is a dwarf quest giver located in the Grizzly Hills.
Tormented Officers are human ghosts located in Shadowfang Keep.
The Torn Fin tribe is a tribe of murlocs found in the Hillsbrad Foothills. They are involved in the quest Elixir of Agony.
__NOTOC__ Tortured Riflemen are dwarf ghosts found in Sword's Rest of the Halls of Reflection. They were members of the 1st Legion who accompanied Arthas Menethil in his campaign to Northrend.
Torgg Thundertotem is a furbolg summoned in the Conquest Pit in Grizzly Hills.
Torgo the Younger is a human fishing at the Violet Hold in Dalaran.
Tortunok is a tauren found in Light's Hammer of Icecrown Citadel. He sells the Tier 10 armor for druids.
Torngasak is a tuskarr drink vendor located at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. Torngasak is injured during the Scourge assault at the Tournament Grounds.

Tortolla is the turtle demigod and, much like Malorne and Goldrinn, an Ancient guardian. He is the patron ancient to all creatures who move effortlessly between land and sea. According to Hamuul Runetotem, he is one of the oldest of the Ancients, having been alive since the time of the Titans. Due to that, he speaks in an old language that has been long forgotten, which proves incomprehensible (at least initially) to players.
Torta's Oversized Choker is a random world drop from level 75-82 Northrend mobs.

__NOTOC__ Tormented Citizens are gnome ghosts found in the Chapel Yard of Kirin'Var Village in the Netherstorm. When aggroed, they will usually transform into Kirin'Var Ghosts, but may rarely transform into a Kirin'Var Spectre instead.
Toshe's Hunting Spears automatically targets nearby enemies on use, and can release 3 spears to different enemies at a time. The item will slay Fleeing Zin'jatar Fathom-Stalkers in 1-2 shoots.
Total Disaster Bracers are a quest reward from Pirate Party Crashers.

Tortunga is a jungle troll quest giver in the Darkspear Hold in Echo Isles in Durotar. He instructs Darkspear trolls to speak to Jornun to secure a ride to Spitescale Cove to join the battle against the naga. He is then seen at the cove, having defeated three Spitescale Wavethrashers. During the Fourth War, he was encountered by Alliance champions who infiltrated the troll capital in order to burn Horde ships stationed there.

__NOTOC__ Torth is a black drake and the mount of Narkrall Rakeclaw. He is first encountered by Horde players at Bloodgulch in the Twilight Highlands, surly and hostile but under the complete control of his master. Narkrall takes him in battle against the Wildhammer dwarves at Thundermar, against the wishes of the Dragonmaw leader, Zaela. An Alliance adventurer encounters Torth during this battle, though the interaction is short-lived. Once Narkrall is slain, Torth flees the village, wheeling about to attack Bloodgulch, enraged with his former captors. He firebombs the town a few times, then departs for The Gullet. Totem-Caller Hood is a quest reward from All Our Friends Are Dead.
